title: Crash with IndexError when using TypeVar(..., Sequence, ...)
body:
The following test case crashes on mypy 0.4.6 and up:

```python
from typing import Sequence, TypeVar

S = TypeVar('S', Sequence)


def my_len(s: S) -> int:
    return len(s)


def crash() -> None:
    my_len((0,))
```
